awardingDepartments: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada

sentences.text: The dataset records federal commitments totalling $214M to the TMT International Observatory consortium under the Strategic Innovation Fund.
The records show nine amendments to the underlying contribution arrangement between fiscal 2015 and fiscal 2024.
Construction of the telescope's primary site has not commenced under the original siting plan.
The international consortium has issued public statements regarding alternative siting arrangements.

The Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada Departmental Results Report for fiscal 2023–24 lists the Strategic Innovation Fund but does not report site-level performance against the TMT contribution.

unverifiable.rationale: The open contributions dataset shows committed amounts and amendments only; construction progress and site disposition are tracked by the consortium and the host jurisdiction, not in the federal open dataset.
